commentary.text: 90+8' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Kike Barja (Osasuna) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Having seen unsporting behavior, Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Aitor Fernandez (Osasuna) is the recipient.
90+7' The referee shows the yellow card to Sergio Herrera (Osasuna).
90+6' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+5' Lass Kourouma (Girona) takes out his opponent after failing to control himself and the referee has no choice but to show him a deserved red card!
90+3' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Joel Roca (Girona) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Cristhian Stuani (Girona) coming on for Vladyslav Vanat.
85' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Victor Munoz is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
85' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

82' What a chance! Lucas Torro (Osasuna) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
81' The attendance for today's match is 12059.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Rincon leaves the pitch and Lass Kourouma (Girona) comes on.
79' Michel has decided to substitute Bryan Gil and he is replaced by Alejandro Frances (Girona).
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Thomas Lemar walks off the pitch to be replaced by Joel Roca (Girona).
78' Osasuna players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
76' Alex Moreno (Girona) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
75' Here is a change. Javi Galan is going off and Alessio Lisci gives the last tactical orders to Abel Bretones (Osasuna).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) will replace Ruben Garcia.

75' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
74' It's a free kick to Osasuna in a dangerous position.
70' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Javi Galan (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
68' Bryan Gil (Girona) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
67' Alessio Lisci has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moi Gomez (Osasuna) replacing Jon Moncayola.
64' The Girona players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Alejandro Hernandez signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
64' Attention! Referee Alejandro Hernandez straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
63' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
61' Girona take a short corner kick.
61' Bryan Gil (Girona) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
61' Girona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
57' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
57' 5:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
56' Osasuna are seeing far more of the ball now.
54' Javi Galan (Osasuna) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
53' Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Valentin Rosier (Osasuna).
52' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
52' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is about to take a corner kick.

51' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Osasuna.
50' One of the players from Osasuna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
49' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera is equal to it and makes an easy save.
48' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
48' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Some neat passing and movement from Girona as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 Goal! Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper low inside the middle of the net. 1:0.
43' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
41' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Ante Budimir (Osasuna) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
39' Thomas Lemar (Girona) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Hernandez stops the game and makes a call.
37' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
30' Bryan Gil (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' The Osasuna players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
29' The possession of the ball – 53:47.
28' Alex Moreno (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
15' Osasuna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
11' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Wonderful movement by Osasuna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
4' Girona fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.
4' Hugo Rincon (Girona) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
1' The first half has started.
Girona will kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will referee today's match.
